quote.quote: The FDA convened the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) on December 18, 2019, to discuss the benefit-risk of tazemetostat in this rare disease given the modest ORR observed in Cohorts 5 and 6 of Study EZH-202
An Advisory Committee (AC) meeting was held on December 18, 2019.

recommendation.text: The committee voted unanimously (11-0) that the benefit of tazemetostat outweighs its risks in the proposed indication.

quote.quote: voted unanimously (11-0) that the demonstrated benefit of tazemetostat outweighs the risks of the drug in the proposed indication.

summary: FDA convened the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) on December 18, 2019, because of the modest overall response rate (pooled ORR 13%) and uncertainty about the clinical benefit of tazemetostat in epithelioid sarcoma. The committee voted 11-0 that the benefits outweighed the risks, and the review documents describe the AC as supportive of the accelerated approval; committee members judged the responses clinically meaningful in this rare disease and considered the secondary-malignancy risk acceptable. The review documents do not tie any specific committee-raised concern to a resulting label, REMS, PMR, or indication change, so no concern-to-change linkages are recorded.
